messages.content: Here are the two options available: (A) calm and (B) rebuke. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: animals are attacking
You should choose calm because rebuke risks Emily panicking during the elk attack.
Here are the two options available: (A) persist and (B) comly. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: emily tryng to reach ranger
You should choose persist because comply risks the ranger not understanding you clearly.
Here are the two options available: (A) Persist and (B) inform. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: informed ranger of information
You should choose Persist because Inform risks the ranger not understanding you clearly, delaying rescue.
Here are the two options available: (A) Suspicious and (B) Supportive. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is haging anf anf about to fall
You should choose Suspicious because Supportive risks Emily panicking and losing grip, which could cause her to fall.
Here are the two options available: (A) Sarcastic and (B) Concerned. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: emily is getting upset and sick at matt
You should choose Sarcastic because Concerned risks Emily getting more upset and sick. 😬
Here are the two options available: (A) Insist and (B) Concede. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is talkin about seeing a ghost
You should choose Insist because Concede risks Emily feeling dismissed and losing trust. 😬
Here are the two options available: (A) Dismisive and (B) Sympathetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: emily is concerned about her friend hannah
You should choose Dismissive because Sympathetic risks Hannah panicking and delaying action. 😬

Here are the two options available: (A) Reluctant and (B) Courgeous. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily doesn't want to go down staris and wants to leave
You should choose Reluctant because Courageous risks Emily rushing into danger and getting hurt. 😬
